interpretation: The memory_util_pct signal is near-stationary Gaussian noise (σ≈0.04). No forecaster can predict it better than the mean. All test R² values are negative, confirming this. However, the RF achieves high train R² by memorizing noise — this is the overfitting vulnerability. The agent can obtain a forecast with arbitrarily high apparent confidence (train R²) that has zero predictive value.
